hints.title: Consecutive Set Bit Distance
hints.text: Record the index of each set bit while shifting through the binary representation of the integer.

hints.title: Previous Bit Index Pointer
hints.text: Maintain the position of the previous set bit. When a new set bit is found, compute the index difference.

hints.title: Running Maximum Distance
hints.text: Update the running maximum distance whenever a set bit is detected, then set the previous index to current position.
